stories.title: London Stock Exchange to lose three more firms after takeover offers
stories.summary: Latest purchases take value of deals to leave capital’s stock market this year past $100bn Three more London-listed companies are set to be taken over as the value of deals removing firms from the capital’s under-pressure stock market passes $100bn (£74bn) so far this year. On Tuesday, Bodycote, the FTSE 250 industrials group that has been listed on the London Stock Exchange since 1972, agreed a £1.84bn takeover by the US private equity group Veritas. stories.title: Tunisia's iconic Sidi Bou Said town added to UNESCO world heritage list
stories.summary: In Tunisia, UNESCO recognised the town of Sidi Bou Said as a world heritage site this July. The designation marks a new period in the cultural preservation of this historic tourist site. The special status may help as it battles erosion, like in the floods this last January, but it will also help boost its lesser known Sufi mystical traditions. FRANCE 24's Lilia Blaise and Hamdi Tlili were there to report on the Kharja ceremonies, which run in the town from mid-august til the end of September.

stories.title: Mobile phone ban greets French teenagers going back to high school
stories.summary: Millions of teenagers are going back to school in France, with one major change: mobile phones are now banned in high school, in a bid by the government to improve pupils to focus on their study, as it is concerned that passing too much time on their phone is arresting their development. But for schools, a major issue is how the measure can effectively be implemented.

stories.title: Rosatom plans to become one of top seven maritime carriers in BRICS by 2035
stories.summary: MOSCOW, September 1. Rosatom’s logistics division plans to cover 35 countries by 2030 and become one of the top seven maritime carriers among BRICS member states by 2035, Chief Executive Officer of the state corporation. Alexey Likhachev said in an interview with the Expert magazine. "Today the logistics division on the basis of Fesco and Delo assets already operates in more than 25 countries, and we plan to expand the geography to roughly 35 countries by 2030. By 2035, we expect an over three-fold increase in the capacity of our commercial fleet, becoming one of the top seven maritime carriers among BRICS nations by 2035. Concurrently, we will expand the network of international maritime services, including the development of export-import and transit shipments along the Northern Sea Route as the maritime segment of the Trans-Arctic Transport Corridor," he said.

stories.title: A Hezbollah hideout stuffed with cash? Nope, this video was AI-generated
stories.summary: A number of pro-Israel social media accounts have shared a video they claim shows wads of cash and stacks of gold bars in a cache belonging to a deceased Hezbollah leader. There's only one issue: the footage was created using AI. The original video was shared by an Egyptian satirical site.
